title: Operator render request
description: A request crosses kr0ki and its artifact cache.
source:
@startuml
actor Operator
rectangle kr0ki
database Cache
Operator -> kr0ki : render source
kr0ki -> Cache : read/write artifact
@enduml

title: Renderer context
description: Operator, kr0ki, and the Kroki backend in a C4 context.
source:
@startuml
!include <C4/C4_Context>
Person(operator, "Operator")
System(kr0ki, "kr0ki", "cached diagram renderer")
System_Ext(kroki, "Kroki", "diagram backend")
Rel(operator, kr0ki, "submits source")
Rel(kr0ki, kroki, "renders")
@enduml
